user.title: Connect to Portainer
user.description: Enter your Portainer address and either an API key (recommended) or a username and password.

data_description.host: For example https://192.168.1.100:9443. Without a scheme, http:// is used.
data_description.api_key: Create one in Portainer under My account → Access tokens. Leave empty to use username and password.
data_description.username: Only needed without an API key.
data_description.password: Only needed without an API key.
data_description.endpoint_id: The number in Portainer URLs such as #!/1/docker/containers (here: 1).
data_description.verify_ssl: Turn off if Portainer uses a self-signed certificate.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot reach Portainer or the environment ID does not exist.
error.invalid_auth: Invalid credentials. Enter an API key or both username and password.
error.ssl_error: The SSL certificate could not be verified. Turn off "Verify SSL certificate" if Portainer uses a self-signed certificate.

abort.already_configured: This Portainer environment is already configured.

data_description.update_interval: How often container status, CPU and memory are read from Portainer.
data_description.update_check_interval: How often image registries are checked for new versions. Docker Hub limits anonymous requests, so keep this high.
data_description.enable_stack_view: Shows compose stacks as their own devices. Changing this recreates the container entities.
data_description.enable_stack_buttons: Start, stop and update buttons per stack.
data_description.enable_container_buttons: Restart and pull image buttons per container.
data_description.enable_resource_sensors: CPU, memory and uptime per running container. Costs one extra request per container and poll.
data_description.enable_version_sensors: Current and available version and digest per container.
data_description.enable_update_sensors: Update entities and "update available" sensors. Portainer itself cannot be updated from here.
data_description.verify_ssl: Turn off if Portainer uses a self-signed certificate.
data_description.notify_service: Where action results are sent, for example notify.mobile_app_phone. Leave empty for persistent notifications.
